description:
The image shows a black train engine with a large front grill and a yellow number "110" on the front. The engine is on a set of tracks, with a red boxcar behind it. The boxcar has white lettering that reads "SOUTHERN" and "50 0189". The engine has a black smokestack and a round headlight. There are two American flags flying on the back of the engine.

The background of the image is a blue sky with white clouds
